title: Tropical fish addon
description: This mod adds three new tropical‑fish‑themed items.
body:
This mod adds three new tropical‑fish‑themed items.
The first is the Fish Tank, a purely decorative block.
The second is the Giant Fish Out of Water, which functions as a sword.
The third is the Smallest Fish in the World, a food item. All textures were created by me, and the mod itself was coded by me using MCreator.
